sentences.text: This Application coming on for orders

upon perusing the application  and upon hearing the arguments of Mr.PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocate for  petitioners and the Public Prosecutor for R1 and R2, the court passed the  following:
Abin Jose vs The Food Safety Officer on 16 September, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114995750/
1  ORDER There shall be an interim stay of all further proceedings of C.C. No.239/2019 pending before the Judicial First Class Magistrate-III, Kozhikode for a period of one month.
Sd/- K.HARIPAL JUDGE 16-09-2021 /True Copy/
